snippet.title: Great Are You Lord (cover) All Sons and Daughters
snippet.description:
Here is our cover of "Great Are You Lord" by All Sons and Daughters. This song was recorded live as a part of our online service on July 12, 2020.

To view the entire service, check out our "Online Services" playlist.

Need prayer? We'd love to connect! Just text "PRAY" to (314) 926-1800 and we'll connect you with someone who can pray with you.
